from src.nodes.base import BaseNode
from src.runtime.planning import get_scene_plan_validator, get_plan_serializer
import json

class Hou_Mcp_Scene_Plan_Validate(BaseNode):
    name = "hou_mcp_scene_plan_validate"

    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-START]
        self.add_input("scene_plan_json",   "string", widget_type="text")
        self.add_output("valid",              "bool")
        self.add_output("errors_json",        "string")
        self.add_output("warnings_json",      "string")
        self.add_output("check_count",        "int")
        self.add_output("validated_plan_json","string")
        # [AUTO-GENERATED-PORTS-END]

    async def execute(self, inputs):
        plan_json = inputs.get("scene_plan_json", "") or ""
        if not plan_json.strip():
            self.log_error("No scene_plan_json provided.")
            return {"valid": False, "errors_json": json.dumps(["No plan provided"]),
                    "warnings_json": "[]", "check_count": 0,
                    "validated_plan_json": "", "exec_out": True}
        try:
            serializer = get_plan_serializer()
            plan = serializer.from_json(plan_json)
            report = get_scene_plan_validator().validate(plan)
            validated_json = serializer.to_json(plan)
            self.log_info(f"Validation: valid={report.valid}, errors={len(report.errors)}, warnings={len(report.warnings)}")
            return {
                "valid":               report.valid,
                "errors_json":         json.dumps(report.errors),
                "warnings_json":       json.dumps(report.warnings),
                "check_count":         report.check_count,
                "validated_plan_json": validated_json,
                "exec_out": True,
            }
        except Exception as exc:
            self.log_error(f"Validation failed: {exc}")
            return {"valid": False, "errors_json": json.dumps([str(exc)]),
                    "warnings_json": "[]", "check_count": 0,
                    "validated_plan_json": "", "exec_out": True}

def register_node():
    return Hou_Mcp_Scene_Plan_Validate
